decisions.reason: The existing message-684 MODIFY already records that mint number one receives no referral commission because no prior NFT exists.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records one ticket per primary mint after the first, disables the first-mint ticket award, and removes the superseded unconditional ticket keys.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already changes the aggregate accounting rule to exclude mint number one and records the first-mint reward exception.
The accepted exception concerns the already-completed first mint, while the current FAQ descriptions address future successful referrals and do not require a new standing first-mint disclosure.
The first-mint exception is a one-off historical condition; the About-page description of future no-code rewards to existing holders remains valid unchanged.
The source changes first-mint reward eligibility, not the requirement that NFT metadata accurately represent rewards that were actually assigned.
Exempting mint number one from ticket and commission issuance does not change the Small Block prize amount, draw condition, winner count, or pool funding.
The decision changes whether the first mint creates a ticket, not how eligible Small Block ticket holders are selected or how randomness is provided.
The first-primary-mint exception does not alter secondary-sale royalties, marketplace enforcement, royalty allocation, or the rule that secondary sales create no referral tickets.
The Mission-page copy describes successful referrals and the recurring prize model; the accepted one-off first-mint exception does not necessarily change that content.
The source concerns the first mint's ticket and commission, not badge definitions, referral milestones, or the replacement of the First Mint badge with First Referral.
The accepted reward exception does not change email delivery, mint-confirmation contents, winner notifications, or reward-access guidance.
